name: aspect-ratio
description: A media frame whose height comes from its width. Six named ratios from the sheet — square, story, portrait, landscape, card, screen — over a recessed well, clipped to the soft radius. A child is sized and cropped from the outside, so the call site is just src and alt. The vocabulary is closed on purpose: 'story' means the same shape wherever it is written, and nobody has to remember which way round 9/16 goes.
